full_prompt_en: A square hard-boiled manga illustration is built around a stern dark-haired man aiming a handgun straight toward the viewer. His face fills the upper half of the frame, tilted slightly downward beneath heavy angular brows. One eye disappears into a heavy black shadow while the other peers forward through sharply inked lines. His arm thrusts out from the lower left; the foreshortened fist and gun barrel become a large dark block in the immediate foreground. A white open-collar shirt cuts through the black jacket as a jagged vertical shape on the lower right. Behind him, the background is a flat, vivid scarlet field, interrupted by black splatters and rough brush breaks around the figure. The image relies on stark black-and-white ink rather than smooth grayscale. Dense black fills occupy the hair, one side of the face, clothing, and weapon; uninked white paper creates strong cheek, hand, and shirt planes. Short scratchy hatching and dry-brush marks model wrinkles, nose, jaw, and fingers, while a few red flecks bleed into the black at the silhouette edge. The composition is aggressively close and frontal, with the weapon's circular muzzle acting as a secondary focal point under the piercing eyes. No detailed location competes with the character; the red void amplifies the dramatic gesture. Lighting is a graphic division between bright white surfaces and deep shadow, giving the face sculptural intensity without naturalistic soft light. The result feels like a pulp-crime cover distilled to three tones: scarlet impact, black weight, and white tension.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形硬派漫画插画围绕一名深发严肃男子展开，他将手枪径直指向观者。脸占据画幅上半部，在沉重棱角眉下微微低倾。一只眼消失在厚重黑影里，另一只眼从锐利墨线中向前凝视。手臂从左下猛伸出来；透视缩短的拳头与枪管在紧贴画面的前景形成大块深色。白色敞领衬衣在右下切开黑夹克，成为锯齿状竖形。背后背景是平坦鲜艳的猩红区域，在人物周围被黑色泼点与粗笔断痕打断。图像依靠强烈黑白墨色，而非平滑灰阶。浓黑填块占据头发、半边脸、衣服与武器；未上墨的白纸形成强有力的脸颊、手和衬衣平面。短而刮擦般的排线与干笔描出皱纹、鼻、下颌和手指，少数红点在剪影边缘渗入黑色。构图逼近而正面，枪口圆形在锐眼之下成为次焦点。没有详细场所与人物竞争；红色虚空放大戏剧手势。光是明白表面与深影之间的图形切分，使脸有雕塑强度而不依靠自然主义柔光。整体像一张被浓缩到三种色调的通俗犯罪封面：猩红冲击、黑色重量、白色张力。
style_prompt_en: Hard-boiled comic ink work compresses a close composition into vivid scarlet, solid black, and exposed white. Heavy angular contours and broad opaque fills carry the main silhouettes; short scratchy hatching, dry-brush breaks, and scattered ink flecks build selected interior texture. One side of a central rounded form can collapse into black while the other stays stark white, creating dramatic sculptural division without continuous shading. A large foreshortened dark shape projects toward the viewer, opposed by sharp white zigzags and a flat red void. The background has no deep setting, only a saturated graphic field broken by irregular splatter near the edges of the focal mass. Hard high-contrast lighting, tight cropping, and frontal pressure make the image urgent. The limited palette and rough printed surface keep the visual rhythm forceful, economical, and unmistakably handmade.
style_prompt_zh: 硬派漫画墨绘把紧凑近景压缩为鲜猩红、实黑与露纸白。厚重棱角轮廓和宽阔不透黑填色承载主要剪影；短促刮擦排线、干笔断痕和散落墨点建立精选内纹。中央圆浑形体一侧可坍入黑色，另一侧保留刺目白色，不靠连续晕染也形成戏剧性雕塑切面。大型透视缩短的深色形体向观者突出，与锐白锯齿线和扁平红色虚空相对。背景没有深层场景，只有在焦点体块边缘被不规则泼点打破的饱和图形色域。强硬高反差明暗、紧裁切与正面压迫让画面紧迫。有限配色和粗糙印刷表面令视觉节奏有力、经济且显然手工。
theme_en: A stern noir comic character aims a handgun directly toward the viewer
theme_zh: 硬派黑色漫画人物举枪正对观者的近景
name: Golgo 13
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
